harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created locked-password opsbot accounts on both nodes, generated the SSH key on node1, enabled node1→node2 command execution as opsbot, and enforced public-key-only SSH authentication for opsbot on both systems. Both nodes retained full functionality after sequential restarts.
actions_performed: Created opsbot accounts with locked passwords on node1 and node2.
Generated an Ed25519 keypair as opsbot on node1.
Installed the public key for opsbot on both systems with correct permissions and SELinux contexts.
Configured and validated per-user SSH policy requiring public-key authentication.
Verified node1 can execute commands on node2 as opsbot and that password-only authentication is rejected.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, verifying changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: opsbot accounts and node-generated SSH key
evidence.summary: opsbot exists on both nodes with locked passwords; its Ed25519 keypair was generated on node1.

evidence.requirement: Require key-based authentication for opsbot on both systems
evidence.summary: Effective sshd settings on both nodes show public-key authentication enabled, password and keyboard-interactive authentication disabled, and AuthenticationMethods set to publickey.

evidence.requirement: node1 can run commands as opsbot on node2
evidence.summary: Remote commands completed on node2 as uid 1001 (opsbot), while password-only attempts failed with Permission denied (publickey), including after both restarts.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 03d44e83-b028-4e4b-a7d2-8e7f63b0beb7, active sshd, retained account/key policy, and successful node1→node2 access.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 325732f1-bc39-4512-b05e-397f42060246, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 6f6e5a4f-c078-4ee6-b43c-60e6313e3f23, active sshd, retained authorized key and key-only policy, successful remote command execution, and continued rejection of password-only authentication.

attempts.summary: Created locked-password opsbot accounts on both nodes, generated the SSH key on node1, enabled node1→node2 command execution as opsbot, and enforced public-key-only SSH authentication for opsbot on both systems. Both nodes retained full functionality after sequential restarts.
